body:
All this boilerplate (css classes, labels, spies) makes the whole tests really hard to read and understand. Any change in the way we handle CSS will break the `maxPages` tests. I know this is not especially related to this issue, but we need to find a better way.

What about:
- Movign the simple if/else/min logic into its own `getMaxPage(maxPages, result.nbPages)` method, so we can test it separatly, with all the edge cases
- Mock this method (and making it return something like `42`), then check that `Pagination` is really called with this props.

Of course, it would be better if we could simply test that a component is called with a specific value in its props.
Why do we need to put a `scrollTo: false`?
We don't it was a copy paste from previous test
Yes having only the relevant information in every test case is easier to read
